title: Exact root transport with the published coefficient line endpoint
statement: For l prime, T with the localization conventions, Chern data c, scalar restriction r, H a strict system, J derived, b:J≅H[2], and e:H≅r.F(lineModule(c)), coefficientRootTransport is exactly rootSystemTransport(r.F,lineModule(c),b,e), with its target written as D(r.F)(line(c)[2]). This is the published line object, definitionally its single-complex presentation. Naming this endpoint avoids repeatedly unfolding the ringed-system category while checking consumers.

def coefficientRootTransport (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (T : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l T]
    (c : SpTowerClasses.Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T)
    (r : Restriction l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T)
    {H : DiagonalSystems l T} {J : DerivedCategory (DiagonalSystems l T)}
    (b : J ≅ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj H)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (e : H ≅ r.F.obj (SpTowerClasses.lineModule l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) c)) :
    J ≅ r.F.mapDerivedCategory.obj ((SpTowerClasses.line l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) c)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
